Treat as SMB-only playbook for now.
generations.memory_44: Enterprise sales-assisted CTA does what it's supposed to: fewer raw signups (-12%, expected since it's a higher-friction path) but qualified leads +24% and qualified revenue +18%, retention flat. generations.memory_57: Referral incentive on established accounts is a solid confirmed win — referral starts +21%, qualified revenue +7%, retention +2%. generations.memory_73: 40% targeted discount for price-sensitive SMB pumped signups (+31%) and qualified revenue (+18%) in the short window, but retention cratered -12% — the cohort we bought basically doesn't make it to renewal. Recommend we stop using this as a acquisition lever unless paired with something that fixes retention.
